candidates.name: PAIRWISE_EQUALIZATION_REWRITE
candidates.internal_principle: Local comparison of finite occupancies: whenever adjacent occupancies differ by at least two, move one token from the larger local multiplicity to the smaller.

exact_N0_substrate.carrier: finite simple undirected relational graph G=(V,E)
exact_N0_substrate.state: finite token multiplicity x:V→N; x is a finite encoding of a token multiset on V

N0_definable_derived_objects: interface edge set I for an explicitly supplied graph composition
introduced_N1_operations: For e={u,v}, if x(u)≥x(v)+2, U_e(x)=x-e_u+e_v; if x(v)≥x(u)+2, use the symmetric move; otherwise e is not legal.
Branching is by choice of a currently legal edge; no edge order is promoted to N0.
candidates.local_update_law: one-token transfer across one native adjacency when the local integer difference is at least 2

scale_refinement_semantics.composition: For disjoint V1,V2 and any explicitly supplied cross-interface I⊆V1×V2, compose by union of vertices, E1∪E2∪I, and concatenation of x1,x2. Parenthesized unions agree up to N0-isomorphism when the same cross-relations are supplied.
scale_refinement_semantics.refinement: No general coarse block dynamics is claimed. Block-sum readout exists, but pairwise updates need not descend to an arbitrary vertex partition.
scale_refinement_semantics.status: PARTIAL_NB_A; exact composition, no general lumpable refinement theorem

candidates.composition_recursion_closure: Every legal update preserves N^V and fixed total M. Composition yields another finite graph/state to which the same law applies.
exact_conservation_monotone_invariant: C is exactly conserved by every legal update.
If d=x(u)-x(v)≥2 and one token moves u→v, then P_after-P_before=(x(u)-1)^2+(x(v)+1)^2-x(u)^2-x(v)^2=-2(d-1)≤-2; symmetric otherwise.

relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.relaxation: Every nontrivial legal step strictly decreases integer P, so every branch terminates.
relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.recurrence: Only terminal fixed states recur under this legal-update relation; nontrivial recurrence is not derived.
relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.branching: N1 choice among legal edges; all invariant/termination claims are branch-independent.

candidates.finite_information_cost: O(|E| log|V| + |V| log(M+1)) bits in a straightforward finite encoding.

debts_derived_from_shared_internal_mecha.NB-A: PARTIAL: graph/interface composition and additive total C under disjoint/cross-edge composition
debts_derived_from_shared_internal_mecha.NB-B: STRONG: exact conservation plus strict well-founded relaxation from the same transfer law
debts_derived_from_shared_internal_mecha.NB-C: PARTIAL: C and P are internal finite readouts; no intrinsic response-family order beyond P

unresolved_debts: No nontrivial recurrent action/rational return structure.
Arbitrary coarse partitions are generally not dynamically lumpable.
No external metrology bridge is part of the candidate.
internal_counterexample_degeneracy: On E=∅ every state is terminal, so relaxation is vacuous.
Stable states need not be unique for a fixed total on a general graph.
Block-sum coarse states can have identical block totals but different availability of cross-block legal moves, so naive refinement closure is false.
candidates.productive_failure_lesson: Exact conservation and genuine finite relaxation can coexist without a metric or continuum, but this does not automatically create recurrence or a valid coarse-scale dynamics.
candidates.new_object_question_exposed: Characterize graph partitions for which this rewrite is strongly lumpable under block-sum quotient.

candidates.name: SIGNED_CANCELLATION_LEDGER
candidates.internal_principle: Oppositely signed tokens of the same native type annihilate in pairs; composition is multiset addition and the uncancelled signed balance is the canonical quotient.

exact_N0_substrate.carrier: finite type set A and state multiplicities p,n:A→N for positive/negative token predicates

N0_definable_derived_objects: componentwise multiset sum of two states on the same A
introduced_N1_operations: For any a with p(a)>0 and n(a)>0, K_a(p,n) decreases both p(a),n(a) by one.
Cancellation order is an N1 branch; no preferred type order is assumed.
candidates.local_update_law: one same-type opposite-sign pair is removed per step

scale_refinement_semantics.refinement: For any finite type map f:A'→A, signed balance pushes forward by (f_*q)_a=Σ_{a':f(a')=a} q_{a'}. Thus the frozen quotient q is functorial under type coarsening.
scale_refinement_semantics.status: STRONG_NB_A at quotient level; raw normal forms are not strictly monoidal because cross-component cancellation may occur after composition

candidates.composition_recursion_closure: Cancellation preserves state nonnegativity; multiset composition is associative/commutative; cancellation may be resumed after every composition.
exact_conservation_monotone_invariant: Every q_a is exactly conserved by cancellation.

relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.recurrence: No nontrivial recurrence; terminal normal form only.
relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.branching: All branches reach the same NF(q), so the rewrite is confluent.

candidates.name: BINARY_CARRY_RELAY
candidates.internal_principle: A two-state finite chain propagates a local carry under repeated application of one endpoint-driven update; nested return periods arise from the same carry law.

exact_N0_substrate.carrier: finite path/chain of L cells with adjacency only; each cell has state bit 0 or 1

N0_definable_derived_objects: the two endpoints as an unordered N0-definable pair
finite chain length L as N2 cardinality readout
introduced_N1_operations: Choose one endpoint as input and the induced successor direction along the chain (N1 choice, not N0).
A(b): toggle the first 0 reached from the input endpoint to 1 and reset all preceding 1s to 0; if all bits are 1, reset all bits to 0.
N2_readout_layer: return period of the first k cells: 2^k
carry-to-level-k event count over a full orbit: 2^(L-k) for k≥1
candidates.local_update_law: endpoint-driven finite carry relay as stated above

scale_refinement_semantics.composition: Concatenating oriented N1 chains of lengths L1 and L2 yields the same law on length L1+L2 and multiplies full return periods: 2^(L1+L2)=2^L1·2^L2.
scale_refinement_semantics.refinement: Prefix extension adds one binary state and doubles the full return period. Orientation remains N1.
scale_refinement_semantics.status: N1-compositional/refinement semantics, not N0-intrinsic because a bare finite path has a reversal automorphism.

candidates.composition_recursion_closure: A is a permutation consisting of one cycle through all 2^L bit states.
exact_conservation_monotone_invariant: No nonconstant state function is invariant under A because the action is transitive on the full state set.
There is no strict well-founded monotone under repeated A because A is periodic.

relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.recurrence: exact full period 2^L; nested prefix return periods 2^k
relaxation_recurrence_branching_typing.branching: none after the N1 input-endpoint choice is fixed

candidates.finite_information_cost: L state bits plus O(log L) structural description for a path; no real-valued parameters.

candidates.name: FINITE_UNION_PROPAGATION
candidates.internal_principle: Native atom-presence information is idempotently joined across an adjacency; the same join gives an exact invariant, a canonical order, and finite relaxation.

N0_definable_derived_objects: global union U=⋃_v S_v as an N2 aggregate
introduced_N1_operations: For edge {u,v}, J_e replaces both endpoint sets by S_u∪S_v; other vertices unchanged.
Choice of legal edge is N1 branching; update uses no metric or probability.
candidates.local_update_law: idempotent local union across one native adjacency

scale_refinement_semantics.composition: Disjoint union of systems preserves componentwise global unions. Adding interface edges recoalesces connected components under the same union law.

scale_refinement_semantics.status: PARTIAL NB-A; exact component-level quotient, not an extensive additive quantity

candidates.composition_recursion_closure: Every edge update remains in (2^A)^V; repeated updates terminate because finite deficit decreases on every nontrivial step.

If S_u≠S_v then P decreases by |S_u△S_v|>0; if equal, update is trivial.

candidates.name: FINITE_REWRITE_ACTION_QUOTIENT
candidates.internal_principle: Close a small family of uniform local rewrites under composition, then use the transformation semigroup itself to generate recurrence classes, a reachability quotient, and an intrinsic monotone.

exact_N0_substrate.carrier: finite set S of N0 relational states/presentations modulo N0-isomorphism within a declared finite scope
native_relations: only those used to define the finite state family

N0_definable_derived_objects: N0-isomorphism classes used only to avoid label duplication in S

Generated transformation semigroup M=<F> under composition.
The arbitrary-table version is explicitly not accepted as a low-information mechanism; generator descriptions must be uniform and target-independent.
N2_readout_layer: q(x)=mutual-reachability class; q(x)=q(y) iff x and y reach each other
exact rational response ratios |O(y)|/|O(x)| when y is reachable from x
candidates.state_carrier: finite S with generated semigroup action M
candidates.local_update_law: x→f_i(x) for one chosen generator f_i

scale_refinement_semantics.status: STRONG algebraic composition at the system/action level; native admissibility of concrete generators remains candidate-specific

exact_conservation_monotone_invariant: If y=f_i(x), then O(y)⊆O(x), hence r(y)≤r(x).
r strictly decreases exactly when the step enters a strictly smaller principal reachable set.
Sink mutual-reachability classes are recurrent/terminal classes of the quotient transition DAG.

candidates.name: CONSERVATIVE_SWAP_GROUP

Generated group Γ is the subgroup of label-position permutations generated by edge transpositions.
N2_readout_layer: orbit cardinality; on a connected n-vertex graph with multiplicities m_a, orbit size is n!/∏_a m_a!
